[RFCS.15.7] **Verb scope.** Of the outbound verbs, v1 records `call` with its
arguments, and `publish` as a marker with no values ([RFCS.27]).
`cache` does not straddle the injection classification
([RFCS.3.4]): `CacheGet` is a pure internal read
([RARC.5.7.9], [LFST.9.2]) — not a replay input at all — while
`CacheSet` / `CacheDelete` are pure outputs. Cache provenance
is therefore cleanly output-only and is not recorded per verb.
v1 records the outbound `CallIssued` plus `correlation_id` and leaves
the request-to-response span to tooling; a `timeout` is the
*absence* of a matching response, inferred rather than
recorded.
